national_questions.qe: Who was appointed as India’s first Chief Election Commissioner in 1950?
national_questions.qh: 1950 में भारत के पहले मुख्य निर्वाचन आयुक्त के रूप में किसकी नियुक्ति हुई?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because Sukumar Sen was appointed in 1950 as India’s first Chief Election Commissioner and oversaw the first general election (1951‑52). 
• Option B is Incorrect because M. N. Kaul served later as CEC (1990‑96). 
• Option C is Incorrect because T. N. Seshan was CEC from 1990‑93. 
• Option D is Incorrect because R. K. Singh never held the post of CEC.

national_questions.qe: Which IT platform was launched by the Defence Minister on Defence Accounts Day to integrate the Indian Army Financial Information System?
national_questions.qh: रक्षा मंत्री ने रक्षा लेखा दिवस पर भारतीय सेना वित्तीय सूचना प्रणाली को एकीकृत करने के लिए कौन सा आईटी प्लेटफ़ॉर्म लॉन्च किया?
oe: SAKSHAM integration with Indian Army Financial Information System
PRISM (Payment Routing and Integrated System Management)
oh: भारतीय सेना वित्तीय सूचना प्रणाली के साथ एकीकरण के लिए SAKSHAM
PRISM (पेमेंट रूटिंग और इंटीग्रेटेड सिस्टम मैनेजमेंट)
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because SAKSHAM integration with the Indian Army Financial Information System was announced by Defence Minister Rajnath Singh on Defence Accounts Day.
• Option B is Incorrect because PRISM is a payment routing and integrated system management platform, not the integration tool for the Army's financial system.
• Option C is Incorrect because the revamped National Compilation System is a separate financial data consolidation platform, not the specific integration with the Army.
• Option D is Incorrect because no such Defence Financial Management System was launched in the announcement.

national_questions.qe: Which authority was directed by the Supreme Court to submit a report on barium-based firecrackers by October 15?
national_questions.qh: सुप्रीम कोर्ट ने बारीयम‑आधारित फायरक्रैकर्स पर रिपोर्ट प्रस्तुत करने के लिए किस प्राधिकरण को 15 अक्टूबर तक निर्देशित किया?
oe: Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change
oh: पर्यावरण, वन और जलवायु परिवर्तन मंत्रालय
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because the Supreme Court bench ordered the Additional Solicitor General to place on record the Central Pollution Control Board’s report on barium‑based firecrackers by 15 October.
• Option A is Incorrect as the Ministry of Environment was not the body specifically directed to submit the report.
• Option C is Incorrect because the National Green Tribunal was not mentioned in the order.
• Option D is Incorrect since the Ministry of Home Affairs was not tasked with the report submission.

national_questions.qe: Under which ministry's order was the maximum holding period for sugar stocks limited to 15 days for dealers?
national_questions.qh: कौन से मंत्रालय के आदेश के तहत शुगर स्टॉक की अधिकतम धारण अवधि को 15 दिनों तक सीमित किया गया?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because the order to limit sugar stock holding period to 15 days for dealers was issued by the Ministry of Consumer Affairs.
• Option B is Incorrect because the Food Processing Ministry did not issue this directive.
• Option C is Incorrect because the Agriculture Ministry was not involved in this stock‑holding rule.
• Option D is Incorrect because the Commerce Ministry did not announce the limit.

national_questions.qe: On which railway section was the permissible speed of Vande Bharat Express increased to 100 km/h, enabling it to cross the Chenab and Anji bridges?
national_questions.qh: किस रेलवे सेक्शन में वंदे भारत एक्सप्रेस की अधिकतम गति 100 किमी/घंटा बढ़ाकर चेनाब और अंजी पुलों को पार किया गया?
oe: Katra‑Banihal section of the Udhampur‑Srinagar‑Baramulla Rail Link
oh: उधमपुर‑सिन्धुर्ग‑बरामुड़ा रेल लिंक का कत्रा‑बनिहाल सेक्शन
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because the speed test was conducted on the 111‑km Katra‑Banihal section of the Udhampur‑Srinagar‑Baramulla Rail Link, raising the limit to 100 km/h.
• Option A is Incorrect; the Delhi‑Mumbai corridor was not involved.
• Option C is Incorrect; the Chennai‑Bengaluru line was not part of this test.
• Option D is Incorrect; the Howrah‑Delhi main line was not used for this speed increase.

national_questions.qe: MOI‑1A, launched on SpaceX’s Transporter‑18 mission, made India the fourth country to possess which capability?
national_questions.qh: स्पेसएक्स के ट्रांसपोर्टर‑18 मिशन पर लॉन्च किए गए MOI‑1A ने भारत को कौन सी क्षमता वाला चौथा देश बना दिया?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because MOI‑1A is India’s first orbital‑computing satellite, making India the fourth nation with orbital computing capability after the USA, EU and China.
• Option A is Incorrect; reusable launch vehicle technology is not the specific capability highlighted.
• Option B is Incorrect; quantum communication is not mentioned in the launch.
• Option D is Incorrect; deep‑space navigation was not part of MOI‑1A’s mission.

national_questions.qe: At what speed did the Vande Bharat Express cross both the Chenab Bridge and the Anji Bridge on the Katra‑Banihal section?
national_questions.qh: कत्रा‑बनिहाल सेक्शन पर चेनाब और अंजी दोनों पुलों को पार करते समय वंदे भारत एक्सप्रेस की गति कितनी थी?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because trial runs recorded the Vande Bharat Express travelling at 100 km/h over both bridges.
• Option A is Incorrect; 80 km/h was the earlier permissible speed on the section.
• Option B is Incorrect; 90 km/h was never authorized for this stretch.
• Option D is Incorrect; 120 km/h exceeds the design speed limit of the bridges.

national_questions.qe: Which archer won India’s first women’s individual recurve gold at the 2026 Asian Games?
national_questions.qh: 2026 एशियन गेम्स में भारत की पहली महिला व्यक्तिगत रीकॉव स्वर्ण पदक किस तीरंदाज़ ने जीता?
national_questions.e:
• Option D is Correct because 17‑year‑old Kumkum Mohod clinched the gold in the women’s individual recurve event.
• Option A is Incorrect; Deepika Kumari has not won this particular medal.
• Option B is Incorrect; Atanu Das competes in the men’s category.
• Option C is Incorrect; Ankita Bhakat did not secure the gold in 2026.

national_questions.qe: Which oil terminal became India’s first plastic‑free terminal in 2026?
national_questions.qh: 2026 में भारत का पहला प्लास्टिक‑फ्री तेल टर्मिनल कौन सा बना?
oe: Jawahar Dweep (Butcher Island) Marine Oil Terminal
oh: जवाहर द्वीप (बचर द्वीप) समुद्री तेल टर्मिनल
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because the Jawahar Dweep Marine Oil Terminal off Mumbai was declared plastic‑free, eliminating single‑use plastics.
• Option A is Incorrect; Kandla has not announced a plastic‑free status.
• Option C is Incorrect; Paradip’s terminal still uses conventional plastic packaging.
• Option D is Incorrect; Nhava Sheva has not implemented a complete plastic‑free policy for its oil terminal.

national_questions.qe: Under which ministry is the PM-SETU scheme being implemented?
national_questions.qh: PM‑SETU योजना किस मंत्रालय के तहत लागू की जा रही है?
oe: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because PM‑SETU (Pradhan Mantri Skilling and Employability Transformation through Upgraded ITIs) is a flagship scheme of the Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship, with a total outlay of Rs 60,000 crore and the identification of 850 ITIs in hub‑spoke clusters.
• Option B is Incorrect because the Ministry of Education is not the nodal agency for this skill‑oriented scheme.
• Option C is Incorrect because the Ministry of Labour and Employment does not administer PM‑SETU.
• Option D is Incorrect because the Ministry of Finance only provides budgetary approval, not scheme implementation.

national_questions.qe: According to the Finance Minister at the 5th Kautilya Economic Conclave, India's general‑government debt is projected to be what percent of GDP in 2031?
national_questions.qh: 5वें काउटिल्य आर्थिक सम्मेलन में वित्त मंत्री के अनुसार, 2031 में भारत का सामान्य‑सरकारी ऋण जीडीपी के कितने प्रतिशत होगा?
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because the Finance Minister cited IMF projections that general‑government debt will fall from 83.4% of GDP in 2026 to 77.7% in 2031.
• Option A is Incorrect; 80.5% is not the figure mentioned.
• Option C is Incorrect; 83.4% refers to the 2026 projection, not 2031.
• Option D is Incorrect; 85.0% is higher than the projected decline.

national_questions.qe: Which bridge, India's first cable‑stayed railway bridge, was crossed by Vande Bharat Express at 100 km/h?
national_questions.qh: भारत का पहला केबल‑स्टेड रेलवे पुल, जिसे वंदे भारत एक्सप्रेस ने 100 किमी/घंटा की गति से पार किया, कौन‑सा है?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because the Anji Bridge on the Katra‑Banihal section of the Udhampur‑Srinagar‑Baramulla Rail Link is India's first cable‑stayed railway bridge, and Vande Bharat Express trains successfully crossed it at a permissible speed of 100 km/h.
• Option A is Incorrect; the Chenab Bridge is a suspension arch bridge, not a cable‑stayed structure.
• Option B is Incorrect; Bogibeel Bridge is a road‑rail bridge over the Brahmaputra, not a cable‑stayed railway bridge.
• Option D is Incorrect; Pamban Bridge is a sea‑link railway bridge, not cable‑stayed.

national_questions.qe: Which Indian waterway was revived as an international cargo route linking Dibrugarh in Assam to Pangaon Port in Bangladesh?
national_questions.qh: कौन सा भारतीय जलमार्ग असम के दिब्रुगढ़ को बांग्लादेश के पंगाओन पोर्ट से जोड़ते हुए अंतरराष्ट्रीय माल मार्ग के रूप में पुनर्जीवित किया गया?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because the cargo vessel used the Brahmaputra (National Waterway‑2) to sail from Dibrugarh to Pangaon.
• Option B is Incorrect; National Waterway‑1 runs along the Ganga, not the Brahmaputra.
• Option C is Incorrect; National Waterway‑3 lies on the west‑coast of India.
• Option D is Incorrect; National Waterway‑4 is on the east‑coast, unrelated to the Assam‑Bangladesh route.

national_questions.qe: What is the length of India's first free‑space quantum key distribution (QKD) link established between BISAG‑N and IIT Gandhinagar?
national_questions.qh: बीआईएसएजी‑एन और आईआईटी गांधीनगर के बीच स्थापित भारत का पहला फ्री‑स्पेस क्वांटम की वितरण (QKD) लिंक कितनी लंबाई का है?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because the link spans 5.56 km as reported.
• Option A is Incorrect; 3.2 km is shorter than the actual length.
• Option B is Incorrect; 4.5 km does not match the stated distance.
• Option D is Incorrect; 7.0 km exceeds the reported length.

national_questions.qe: Which Indian state is hosting the country's first AI Data Centre Park with a planned 100‑MW AI‑ready campus?
national_questions.qh: कौन सा भारतीय राज्य 100 मेगावॉट AI‑रेडी कैंपस के साथ देश का पहला AI डेटा सेंटर पार्क स्थापित कर रहा है?
national_questions.e:
• Option D is Correct because the AI Data Centre Park is being set up in Chhattisgarh with a 100‑MW campus.
• Option A is Incorrect; Karnataka has no mention of this specific AI park.
• Option B is Incorrect; Maharashtra is not the announced location.
• Option C is Incorrect; Gujarat is not cited for this project.

national_questions.qe: Under which ministry is the Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana‑Gramin (PMAY‑G) scheme administered, under which Andhra Pradesh is piloting 3D‑printed rural houses?
national_questions.qh: अंडर किस मंत्रालय के तहत प्रधानमंत्री आवास योजना‑ग्रामीण (PMAY‑G) कार्यान्वित है, जिसके अंतर्गत आंध्र प्रदेश 3डी‑प्रिंटेड ग्रामीण घरों का पायलट चला रहा है?
oe: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
Ministry of New and Renewable Energy
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because PMAY‑G is a flagship rural housing scheme administered by the Ministry of Rural Development.
• Option B is Incorrect because the Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs handles the urban component (PMAY‑U).
• Option C is Incorrect because the Ministry of New and Renewable Energy deals with renewable energy projects, not housing.
• Option D is Incorrect because the Ministry of Commerce is unrelated to housing schemes.

national_questions.qe: Which state’s port authority installed India’s first offshore wind turbine at V. O. Chidambaranar Port?
national_questions.qh: कौन से राज्य के पोर्ट अथॉरिटी ने वी. ओ. चिदंबरनर पोर्ट में भारत का पहला ऑफ़शोर विंड टरबाइन स्थापित किया?
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because V. O. Chidambaranar Port is located in Thoothukudi, Tamil Nadu, and the Tamil Nadu government’s port authority installed the turbine.
• Option A is Incorrect because Kerala does not host this port.
• Option C is Incorrect because Maharashtra’s ports are on the western coast, not Thoothukudi.
• Option D is Incorrect because Gujarat’s offshore wind projects are elsewhere.

national_questions.qe: Which ministry is the nodal agency for the construction of India’s first underwater road‑cum‑rail tunnel in Assam?
national_questions.qh: असम में भारत के पहले अंडरवॉटर रोड‑क्यूम‑रेल टनल के निर्माण के लिए कौन सा मंत्रालय मुख्य एजेंसी है?
oe: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because the tunnel is a road‑rail project and the Ministry of Road Transport and Highways is the nodal agency for such infrastructure.
• Option A is Incorrect because the Railways ministry handles rail‑only projects.
• Option B is Incorrect because the Shipping ministry deals with maritime transport, not land tunnels.
• Option D is Incorrect because the Home Affairs ministry is unrelated to civil infrastructure.

national_questions.qe: Which two institutions were linked in India’s first free‑space quantum key distribution (QKD) demonstration?
national_questions.qh: भारत के पहले फ्री‑स्पेस क्वांटम की‑डिस्ट्रिब्यूशन (QKD) प्रदर्शन में किन दो संस्थानों को जोड़ा गया था?
national_questions.e:
• Option D is Correct because the 5.56 km free‑space QKD link was demonstrated between the BISAG‑N testbed and IIT Gandhinagar.
• Option A is Incorrect; ISRO and DRDO collaborate on space and defence, not this QKD trial.
• Option B is Incorrect; those institutes were not part of the demonstration.
• Option C is Incorrect; NIT Trichy and BARC were not involved.

national_questions.qe: Under which ministry will the Integrated Transport and Logistics Authority (ITLA) be established?
national_questions.qh: इंटीग्रेटेड ट्रांसपोर्ट एंड लॉजिस्टिक्स अथॉरिटी (ITLA) किस मंत्रालय के तहत स्थापित होगी?
oe: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways
oh: राज्य सड़क परिवहन एवं राजमार्ग मंत्रालय
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because the Cabinet decision placed ITLA under the Ministry of Commerce and Industry to coordinate multi‑modal logistics.
• Option A is Incorrect; the Ministry of Road Transport and Highways handles roads only.
• Option C is Incorrect; the Ministry of Railways focuses solely on rail transport.
• Option D is Incorrect; the Ministry of Finance does not oversee operational logistics authorities.

national_questions.qe: As of the latest report, how many cumulative teleconsultations have been recorded on the eSanjeevani platform?
national_questions.qh: नवीनतम रिपोर्ट के अनुसार, ई‑संजीवनी प्लेटफ़ॉर्म पर कुल कितनी टेली‑कंसल्टेशन हुई हैं?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because the platform crossed the 50 crore (500 million) teleconsultation milestone.
• Option A is Incorrect; the figure is far lower than the reported milestone.
• Option B is Incorrect; 25 crore is half of the actual count.
• Option D is Incorrect; 75 crore exceeds the current cumulative total.

national_questions.qe: Which Indian vaccine manufacturer developed Cervavac, the country's first indigenous HPV vaccine?
national_questions.qh: भारत का पहला स्वदेशी एचपीवी वैक्सीन, सर्वावैक, किस भारतीय वैक्सीन निर्माता ने विकसित किया?
national_questions.e:
• Option D is Correct because Cervavac was developed by the Serum Institute of India in collaboration with DBT‑BIRAC and other partners.
• Option A is Incorrect; Bharat Biotech is known for other vaccines but not Cervavac.
• Option B is Incorrect; Panacea Biotec did not develop this HPV vaccine.
• Option C is Incorrect; Biological E. Limited is not associated with Cervavac.

national_questions.qe: What is the name of India’s first indigenous fleet support ship built by Hindustan Shipyard Limited?
national_questions.qh: हिंदुस्तान शिपयार्ड लिमिटेड द्वारा निर्मित भारत का पहला स्वदेशी फ्लीट सपोर्ट शिप किस नाम से जाना जाता है?
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because the ship launched on 23 May 2026 is officially named FSS‑1 ‘Surya’, the first indigenous fleet support ship for the Indian Navy.
• Option A is Incorrect because INS Shakti is a replenishment tanker commissioned earlier, not the first indigenous FSS.
• Option C is Incorrect because INS Jyoti is a different auxiliary vessel.
• Option D is Incorrect because INS Deepak is a modern fleet tanker, not the first indigenous fleet support ship.

national_questions.qe: What was the distance over which India’s first free‑space quantum key distribution trial was successfully demonstrated?
national_questions.qh: भारत के पहले फ्री‑स्पेस क्वांटम की‑डिस्ट्रिब्यूशन परीक्षण की सफल दूरी कितनी थी?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because the trial between BISAG‑N and IIT Gandhinagar covered a free‑space link of 5.56 km.
• Option A is Incorrect; 2.3 km was not the reported distance.
• Option B is Incorrect; 4.0 km does not match the experimental setup.
• Option D is Incorrect; 10 km exceeds the actual demonstrated range.

national_questions.qe: On which railway section did the Vande Bharat Express achieve a speed of 100 km/h across the Chenab and Anji bridges?
national_questions.qh: वंदे भारत एक्सप्रेस ने चेनाब और अंजि पुलों पर १०० किमी/घंटा की गति किस रेलवे सेक्शन में हासिल की?
oe: Katra‑Banihal section of the Udhampur‑Srinagar‑Baramulla Rail Link
oh: उधमपुर‑स्रीनगर‑बरामुड़ा रेल लिंक का कटरा‑बनिहाल सेक्शन
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because the speed trial was conducted on the 111‑km Katra‑Banihal stretch of the Udhampur‑Srinagar‑Baramulla Rail Link, raising permissible speed to 100 km/h.
• Option B is Incorrect; the Delhi‑Mumbai corridor was not involved in this test.
• Option C is Incorrect; the Howrah‑Chennai route is unrelated.
• Option D is Incorrect; the Pune‑Mumbai line was not part of the trial.

national_questions.qe: Which joint initiative featuring MY Bharat Volunteers and NCC Cadets was launched to promote youth-led community mobilization for the TB Mukt Bharat Abhiyaan?
national_questions.qh: टीबी मुक्त भारत अभियान के लिए युवा-नेतृत्व वाली सामुदायिक लामबंदी को बढ़ावा देने के लिए माय भारत (MY Bharat) स्वयंसेवकों और एनसीसी कैडेटों को मिलाकर कौन सी संयुक्त पहल शुरू की गई है?
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because JOSH (Joint Squad for Health) Teams bring together Class-I Officers, MY Bharat Volunteers, and NCC Cadets across 55 districts to accelerate the TB Mukt Bharat Abhiyaan.
• Option A is Incorrect because AMRIT refers to affordable medicine outlets.
• Option C is Incorrect because SEVA Brigades is not a registered health squad under this ministry framework.
• Option D is Incorrect because SANKALP is associated with skill development initiatives.

national_questions.qe: Under the BHAVYA Rasayan Scheme and Critical Mineral Mission, by which target year does the Government of India aim to transform the Indian chemical sector into a USD 1 trillion industry?
national_questions.qh: भव्य रसायन योजना और क्रिटिकल मिनरल मिशन के तहत, भारत सरकार का लक्ष्य किस लक्षित वर्ष तक भारतीय रसायन क्षेत्र को 1 ट्रिलियन अमेरिकी डॉलर का उद्योग बनाना है?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because the Government of India announced a target to develop the Indian chemical sector into a USD 1 trillion industry by 2040 during the launch of India Chem.
• Option A is Incorrect because 2030 is too short-term for achieving a $1 trillion sector milestone.
• Option B is Incorrect because 2035 is not the officially set target year for this roadmap.
• Option D is Incorrect because 2047 is the overall target year for 'Viksit Bharat' rather than the chemical sector specific target.

national_questions.qe: Under the Trade and Economic Partnership Agreement (TEPA) signed between India and EFTA nations, what amount of investment is targeted to be attracted into India over a 15-year period?
national_questions.qh: भारत और ईएफटीए (EFTA) देशों के बीच हस्ताक्षरित व्यापार और आर्थिक साझेदारी समझौते (TEPA) के तहत 15 वर्षों की अवधि में भारत में कितने निवेश को आकर्षित करने का लक्ष्य रखा गया है?
national_questions.e:
• Option D is Correct because TEPA aims to attract USD 100 billion in investment and generate 10 lakh direct jobs in India over a span of 15 years.
• Option A is Incorrect because USD 25 billion is far lower than the bilateral commitment.
• Option B is Incorrect because USD 50 billion represents only half of the agreed investment goal.
• Option C is Incorrect because USD 75 billion does not match the official TEPA commitment figures.

national_questions.qe: Which indigenously designed Indian Navy vessel, the first fleet support ship, was launched by Defence Minister Rajnath Singh at Hindustan Shipyard Limited?
