national_questions.qe: The Supreme Court directed the Centre to ensure uninterrupted operation of which urban transport service?
national_questions.qh: सुप्रीम कोर्ट ने केंद्र को किस शहरी परिवहन सेवा के निरंतर संचालन को सुनिश्चित करने का निर्देश दिया?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because the Court specifically ordered that metro services be maintained without disruption.
• Option B is Incorrect as city bus services were not mentioned in the directive.
• Option C is Incorrect because inter‑state rail freight was not part of the order.
• Option D is Incorrect since domestic airline operations were not addressed by the Court.

national_questions.qe: Which of the following is NOT a feature of the recent modernization of Indian lighthouses?
national_questions.qh: भारतीय लाइटहाउस के हालिया आधुनिकीकरण की निम्नलिखित में से कौन सी विशेषता नहीं है?
oe: Installation of Automatic Identification System (AIS) shore stations
Development of lighthouse sites as tourism destinations
oh: सभी लाइटहाउस सौर ऊर्जा से चलते हैं
ऑटोमैटिक आइडेंटिफिकेशन सिस्टम (AIS) शोर स्टेशन की स्थापना
लाइटहाउस स्थलों को पर्यटन गंतव्य के रूप में विकसित करना
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because none of the lighthouses have been converted to nuclear power; they are solar‑powered.
• Option A is Incorrect because all Indian lighthouses have indeed been made 100 % solar‑powered.
• Option B is Incorrect because 87 AIS shore stations have been installed at lighthouse locations.
• Option D is Incorrect as many lighthouses have been developed with museums, pathways and gardens for tourism.

national_questions.qe: Which state's Visakhapatnam ITI cluster became the first in India to receive PM‑SETU approval?
national_questions.qh: कौन से राज्य का विशाखापत्तनम आईटीआई क्लस्टर भारत में पहला पीएम‑सेटु अनुमोदन प्राप्त करने वाला बना?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because the Visakhapatnam ITI cluster in Andhra Pradesh was the first ITI cluster in India to receive approval from the PM‑SETU National Steering Committee, with a Rs 200 crore investment to upgrade four government ITIs.
• Option B is Incorrect because Karnataka has not yet reported a PM‑SETU‑approved ITI cluster.
• Option C is Incorrect because Tamil Nadu’s ITI clusters are yet to obtain PM‑SETU clearance.
• Option D is Incorrect because Maharashtra’s ITI initiatives are separate from the PM‑SETU scheme mentioned.

national_questions.qe: According to the IEA Oil Market Report, what is the projected global oil supply (in million barrels per day) for the current year?
national_questions.qh: IEA के तेल बाजार रिपोर्ट के अनुसार इस वर्ष वैश्विक तेल आपूर्ति (मिलियन बैरल प्रति दिन) कितनी अनुमानित है?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because the IEA projects global oil supply to decline to 100.7 million barrels per day this year before rebounding in 2027.
• Option A is Incorrect because 95.3 million bpd is lower than the IEA forecast.
• Option B is Incorrect because 98.5 million bpd does not match the reported figure.
• Option D is Incorrect because 103.2 million bpd exceeds the IEA projection.

national_questions.qe: What is the new name given to the National Social Assistance Programme (NSAP) for the period 2026‑27 to 2030‑31 as approved by the Union Cabinet?
national_questions.qh: केंद्रीय कैबिनेट ने 2026-27 से 2030-31 तक राष्ट्रीय सामाजिक सहायता कार्यक्रम (NSAP) का नया नाम क्या रखा?
oe: Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act
oh: महात्मा गांधी राष्ट्रीय ग्रामीण रोजगार गारंटी अधिनियम
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because the Union Cabinet renamed NSAP as Pradhan Mantri Samajik Sahayata Yojana for 2026‑27 to 2030‑31.
• Option B is Incorrect; Jan Dhan Yojana is a financial inclusion scheme, not a social assistance programme.
• Option C is Incorrect; MGNREGA is a rural employment guarantee act.
• Option D is Incorrect; Swachh Bharat Mission pertains to sanitation, not social assistance.

national_questions.qe: To what level has India's public debt‑to‑GDP ratio fallen over the past five years, as announced at the Bloomberg New Economy Forum?
national_questions.qh: पिछले पाँच वर्षों में भारत का सार्वजनिक ऋण‑से‑जीडीपी अनुपात किस स्तर तक गिरा?
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because Union Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw stated that the ratio fell from 61 % to 55 % over the last five years.
• Option A is Incorrect; 61 % was the earlier level before the decline.
• Option C is Incorrect; 45 % is not the reported figure.
• Option D is Incorrect; 70 % is higher than the current ratio.

national_questions.qe: Which ministry was represented by Union Minister Bhupender Yadav during the launch of public EV charging stations and air‑quality monitoring stations in New Delhi?
national_questions.qh: न्यू दिल्ली में सार्वजनिक ई‑वी चार्जिंग स्टेशन और वायु‑गुणवत्ता मॉनिटरिंग स्टेशन के उद्घाटन के दौरान केंद्रीय मंत्री भूपेंद्र यादव ने किस मंत्रालय का प्रतिनिधित्व किया?
oe: Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change
Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
Ministry of Road Transport and Highways
oh: पर्यावरण, वन और जलवायु परिवर्तन मंत्रालय
गृह एवं शहरी मामलों का मंत्रालय
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because Bhupender Yadav is the Union Minister of Environment, Forest and Climate Change, the nodal ministry for EV‑charging infrastructure and ambient air‑quality monitoring.
• Option B is Incorrect as the Ministry of Power did not lead this Delhi launch.
• Option C is Incorrect because the Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs was not involved.
• Option D is Incorrect as the Ministry of Road Transport and Highways was not represented.

national_questions.qe: Who supervised the Special Intensive Voter Enrolment Drive conducted in Jammu & Kashmir on October 10‑11, 2024?
national_questions.qh: 10‑11 अक्टूबर 2024 को जम्मू और कश्मीर में आयोजित विशेष तीव्र मतदाता नामांकन अभियान की निगरानी किसने की?
oe: Chief Electoral Officer of Jammu & Kashmir
oh: जम्मू और कश्मीर के मुख्य निर्वाचन अधिकारी
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because the drive was supervised by the Chief Electoral Officer of Jammu & Kashmir under the Election Commission’s guidelines.
• Option A is Incorrect; the Election Commission of India set the overall policy but did not directly supervise the field operation.
• Option C is Incorrect as the Ministry of Home Affairs was not the supervising authority.
• Option D is Incorrect because the State Election Commission deals with local body elections, not parliamentary voter enrolment.

national_questions.qe: Which agency installed the 87 Automatic Identification System (AIS) shore stations at Indian lighthouses?
national_questions.qh: भारतीय लाइटहाउसों में 87 ऑटोमैटिक आइडेंटिफिकेशन सिस्टम (AIS) शोर स्टेशन किस एजेंसी ने स्थापित किए?
oe: Directorate General of Lighthouses and Lightships (DGLL)
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because the Directorate General of Lighthouses and Lightships (DGLL) is the nodal agency that installed the AIS shore stations to modernise navigation.
• Option A is Incorrect; the Directorate General of Shipping oversees shipping regulations, not lighthouse AIS installations.
• Option B is Incorrect as the Ministry of Tourism promotes tourism but does not handle navigational equipment.
• Option D is Incorrect because the Indian Coast Guard operates patrols, not lighthouse infrastructure.

national_questions.qe: What is the revised target for creating Lakhpati Didis announced at the National SARAS Mela 2026?
national_questions.qh: राष्ट्रीय SARAS मेले 2026 में लखपति दिदियों के लिए निर्धारित नया लक्ष्य क्या है?
national_questions.e:
• Option D is Correct because the Union Rural Development Minister announced a new target of 6 crore Lakhpati Didis.
• Option A is Incorrect as the earlier target of 3 crore has already been achieved.
• Option B is Incorrect because 4 crore was never announced.
• Option C is Incorrect because 5 crore is not the stated target.

national_questions.qe: What was the value of India's defence exports in FY 2025‑26 as announced by the Defence Minister?
national_questions.qh: वित्तीय वर्ष 2025‑26 में भारत के रक्षा निर्यात का मूल्य रक्षा मंत्री द्वारा किस राशि के रूप में घोषित किया गया?
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because the minister stated that defence exports crossed ₹38,000 crore in FY 2025‑26.
• Option A is Incorrect; ₹3,860 crore is far below the reported figure.
• Option C is Incorrect; ₹380 crore is not the announced amount.
• Option D is Incorrect; ₹38 lakh crore is a mis‑representation of the actual value.

national_questions.qe: What was the total sales value of Khadi and Village Industries products in FY 2025‑26?
national_questions.qh: वित्तीय वर्ष 2025‑26 में खादी एवं ग्राम उद्योग उत्पादों की कुल बिक्री मूल्य क्या था?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because KVIC reported sales of ₹1.87 lakh crore in FY 2025‑26.
• Option A is Incorrect; ₹1.5 lakh crore understates the actual sales.
• Option B is Incorrect; ₹1.6 lakh crore is not the reported figure.
• Option D is Incorrect; ₹2.0 lakh crore exceeds the stated amount.

national_questions.qe: Which airport in India has inaugurated the country's first terminal equipped with geothermal heating?
national_questions.qh: कौन से हवाई अड्डे ने भारत का पहला जियोथर्मल हीटिंग वाला टर्मिनल inaugurated किया है?
oe: Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj International Airport, Mumbai
oh: कुशोक बकुला रिम्पोचे हवाई अड्डा, लेह
इंदिरा गांधी अंतरराष्ट्रीय हवाई अड्डा, दिल्ली
छत्रपति शिवाजी महाराज अंतरराष्ट्रीय हवाई अड्डा, मुंबई
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because the Kushok Bakula Rimpochee Airport terminal in Leh was inaugurated as India’s first airport terminal with geothermal heating, enhancing energy efficiency in a high‑altitude region.
• Option B is Incorrect; Delhi’s IGI Airport does not have a geothermal‑heated terminal.
• Option C is Incorrect; Mumbai’s airport uses conventional HVAC systems.
• Option D is Incorrect; Bengaluru’s airport also lacks geothermal heating.

national_questions.qe: Which two projects were inaugurated by Prime Minister Narendra Modi in Ladakh under the Rs 3,350 crore development plan?
national_questions.qh: प्रधानमंत्री नरेंद्र मोदी ने लद्दाख में 3,350 करोड़ रुपये के विकास योजना के तहत कौन से दो प्रोजेक्ट्स का उद्घाटन किया?
oe: A new highway and a solar farm
Geothermal‑heated airport terminal at Leh and the Petroglyph Conservation Park
An international university and a space research centre
A hydroelectric dam and a wildlife sanctuary
oh: एक नई हाईवे और एक सोलर फार्म
लेह में जियोथर्मल‑हीटेड हवाई अड्डा टर्मिनल और पेट्रोग्लिफ़ संरक्षण पार्क
एक अंतरराष्ट्रीय विश्वविद्यालय और एक अंतरिक्ष अनुसंधान केंद्र
एक जलविद्युत बाँध और एक वन्यजीव अभयारण्य
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because PM Modi inaugurated the geothermal‑heated terminal at Leh Airport and the dedicated Petroglyph Conservation Park, both part of the ₹3,350 crore Ladakh development package.
• Option A is Incorrect; the mentioned highway and solar farm were not part of the announced Rs 3,350 crore projects.
• Option C is Incorrect; no university or space centre was launched under this scheme.
• Option D is Incorrect; neither a dam nor a sanctuary was inaugurated in this context.

national_questions.qe: As of 2026, how many kilometres of viaduct have been completed for the Mumbai‑Ahmedabad high‑speed rail corridor?
national_questions.qh: 2026 तक मुंबई‑अहमदाबाद हाई‑स्पीड रेल कॉरिडोर के लिए कितने किलोमीटर वायडक्ट पूरा हो चुका है?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because official updates state that 371 km of viaduct have been completed for the Mumbai‑Ahmedabad bullet‑train project.
• Option A is Incorrect; 200 km is far below the reported progress.
• Option B is Incorrect; 250 km does not match the official figure.
• Option D is Incorrect; 508 km represents the total corridor length, not the completed viaduct portion.

national_questions.qe: Which agency has become India's first test agency to provide integrated vehicle cybersecurity testing, verification, validation, R&D and homologation under one roof?
national_questions.qh: कौन सी एजेंसी भारत की पहली परीक्षण एजेंसी बन गई है जो एक ही छत के तहत एकीकृत वाहन साइबर सुरक्षा परीक्षण, सत्यापन, मान्यकरण, अनुसंधान एवं विकास और होमोलोगेशन प्रदान करती है?
oe: National Automotive Testing and R&D Infrastructure (NATRiP)
Ministry of Road Transport and Highways
oh: नेशनल ऑटोमोटिव टेस्टिंग एंड आरएंडडी इन्फ्रास्ट्रक्चर (NATRiP)
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because ARAI was announced as India's first test agency offering integrated vehicle cybersecurity services, covering AIS‑189, AIS‑190 compliance, VAPT, TARA, HSM, SSM and CVE tracking.
• Option B is Incorrect because NATRiP is a testing infrastructure network but has not been designated as the first integrated vehicle cybersecurity service provider.
• Option C is Incorrect because the Ministry formulates policy but does not directly conduct integrated testing.
• Option D is Incorrect because SIAM is an industry body, not a testing agency.

national_questions.qe: In which Indian city will IBM install the country's first quantum computer, scheduled to become operational in early 2027?
national_questions.qh: किस भारतीय शहर में IBM देश का पहला क्वांटम कंप्यूटर स्थापित करेगा, जो 2027 की शुरुआत में संचालन में आएगा?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because IBM announced the installation of India's first quantum computer at the Andhra Pradesh Quantum Valley tech park in Amaravati, expected to be operational in early 2027.
• Option A is Incorrect as Bengaluru hosts several tech initiatives but not this specific quantum computer project.
• Option B is Incorrect because Hyderabad is not the designated location for this IBM quantum installation.
• Option D is Incorrect as Mumbai has no announced plan for the first national quantum computer deployment.

national_questions.qe: In which city has the Indian Institute of Creative Technologies (IICT) set up its campus to build industry-ready talent for the AVGC sector?
national_questions.qh: AVGC (एनिमेशन, विजुअल इफेक्ट्स, गेमिंग और कॉमिक्स) क्षेत्र में प्रतिभा विकसित करने के लिए 'भारतीय रचनात्मक प्रौद्योगिकी संस्थान' (IICT) ने किस शहर में अपना परिसर स्थापित किया है?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because the Ministry of Information and Broadcasting operationalized the Indian Institute of Creative Technologies (IICT) at a temporary campus in Mumbai to foster AVGC, XR, and gaming talent.
• Option A is Incorrect because Bengaluru is recognized for its technology software hubs, not IICT.
• Option B is Incorrect because Hyderabad hosts major animation studios but IICT was established in Mumbai.
• Option D is Incorrect because New Delhi serves as administrative headquarters for MIB.

national_questions.qe: India expressed strong solidarity and condemned recent attacks targeting civil infrastructure and energy installations in which West Asian nation?
national_questions.qh: भारत ने हाल ही में किस पश्चिम एशियाई देश के नागरिक बुनियादी ढांचे और ऊर्जा प्रतिष्ठानों को निशाना बनाकर किए गए हमलों की कड़ी निंदा करते हुए उसके प्रति अपनी एकजुटता व्यक्त की?
national_questions.e:
• Option D is Correct because India officially condemned attacks on civil infrastructure including Aramco facilities in Saudi Arabia, reaffirming commitment to Saudi sovereignty.
• Option A is Incorrect because the specific diplomatic statement and condemnation were issued regarding infrastructure attacks in Saudi Arabia.
• Option B is Incorrect because Qatar was not the target of the recent civil infrastructure attacks mentioned by MEA.
• Option C is Incorrect because Iran was not the target country in this official Ministry of External Affairs solidarity statement.

national_questions.qe: The Commission for Air Quality Management in National Capital Region and Adjoining Areas (CAQM), which monitors agricultural residue burning and air pollution, was established under which statutory enactment?
national_questions.qh: राष्ट्रीय राजधानी क्षेत्र और आसपास के क्षेत्रों में वायु गुणवत्ता प्रबंधन आयोग (CAQM), जो कृषि अवशेष जलाने और वायु प्रदूषण की निगरानी करता है, किस वैधानिक अधिनियम के तहत स्थापित किया गया था?
oe: Air (Prevention and Control of Pollution) Act, 1981
Commission for Air Quality Management in National Capital Region and Adjoining Areas Act, 2021
oh: राष्ट्रीय राजधानी क्षेत्र और आसपास के क्षेत्रों में वायु गुणवत्ता प्रबंधन आयोग अधिनियम, 2021
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because the Commission for Air Quality Management in National Capital Region and Adjoining Areas (CAQM) was established under a dedicated parliamentary legislation, the CAQM Act, 2021, to coordinate air quality improvement measures and stubble burning controls.
• Option A is Incorrect because the Air Act of 1981 provided for Central and State Pollution Control Boards, not CAQM.
• Option B is Incorrect because while earlier temporary bodies like EPCA were set up under EPA 1986, CAQM operates under its distinct 2021 statute.
• Option D is Incorrect because the NGT Act, 2010 relates to judicial adjudication of environmental disputes.

national_questions.qe: Which primary payload aboard India's Aditya-L1 solar mission is specifically designed to continuously observe the solar corona and Coronal Mass Ejections (CMEs)?
national_questions.qh: भारत के आदित्य-L1 सौर मिशन पर कौन सा प्राथमिक पेलोड विशेष रूप से सौर कोरोना और कोरोनल मास इजेक्शन (CMEs) का निरंतर अवलोकन करने के लिए डिज़ाइन किया गया है?
oe: High Energy L1 Orbiting X-ray Spectrometer (HEL1OS)
oh: हाई एनर्जी L1 ऑर्बिटिंग एक्स-रे स्पेक्ट्रोमीटर (HEL1OS)
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because the Visible Emission Line Coronagraph (VELC) is the primary payload developed by the Indian Institute of Astrophysics (IIA) to image the solar corona and study coronal mass ejections.
• Option A is Incorrect because PAPA measures solar wind composition and energetic ions.
• Option C is Incorrect because SoLEXS measures low-energy X-ray flux from the Sun.
• Option D is Incorrect because HEL1OS studies high-energy solar X-ray flares.

national_questions.qe: Which vessel holds the distinction of being the first major warship constructed by a private shipyard to be commissioned into the Indian Navy?
national_questions.qh: निजी शिपयार्ड द्वारा निर्मित किस जहाज को भारतीय नौसेना में शामिल होने वाले पहले प्रमुख युद्धपोत होने का गौरव प्राप्त है?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because INS Samarthak is the first major warship built by a private sector shipyard (L&T Kattupalli in Tamil Nadu) and commissioned into the Indian Navy with over 75% indigenous content.
• Option B is Incorrect because INS Ikshak is a Survey Vessel (Large) constructed by public sector shipyard GRSE.
• Option C is Incorrect because INS Nirdeshak is also a public-sector survey vessel.
• Option D is Incorrect because INS Surat is a Visakhapatnam-class stealth guided missile destroyer built by Mazagon Dock Shipbuilders Limited (MDL).

national_questions.qe: Which instrument aboard Aditya‑L1 is specifically designed to observe the solar corona?
national_questions.qh: अडित्य‑L1 में कौन सा उपकरण विशेष रूप से सौर कोरोना का अवलोकन करने के लिए डिज़ाइन किया गया है?
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because the Visible Emission Line Coronagraph (VELC) on Aditya‑L1 is dedicated to imaging the solar corona and studying coronal mass ejections and solar flares.
• Option A is Incorrect because the Solar X‑ray Monitor observes X‑ray flux, not the corona directly.
• Option C is Incorrect because the Ultraviolet Imaging Telescope studies the chromosphere and transition region, not the corona.
• Option D is Incorrect because the Magnetometer measures magnetic fields, not coronal structures.

national_questions.qe: In which year did ISRO successfully launch its first indigenous satellite launch vehicle, SLV‑3?
national_questions.qh: आईएसआरओ ने अपना पहला स्वदेशी सैटेलाइट लॉन्च वाहन, SLV‑3, सफलतापूर्वक कब लॉन्च किया?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because SLV‑3 lifted off on 20 July 1980, placing the Rohini satellite into orbit and marking India’s first indigenous launch capability.
• Option A is Incorrect; 1975 predates the development of SLV‑3.
• Option B is Incorrect; the vehicle was still under testing in 1978.
• Option D is Incorrect; by 1982 ISRO had already moved on to the PSLV program.

national_questions.qe: According to the Department of Space, to what estimated value is India's space economy projected to grow over the next 7 to 8 years from its present valuation of around $9 billion?
national_questions.qh: अंतरिक्ष विभाग के अनुसार, भारत की वर्तमान लगभग $9 बिलियन की अंतरिक्ष अर्थव्यवस्था के अगले 7 से 8 वर्षों में बढ़कर कितने डॉलर तक पहुँचने का अनुमान है?
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct: Union Minister of State for Space Dr. Jitendra Singh stated that India's space economy, currently valued at around $9 billion, is projected to expand to $40–45 billion over the next 7 to 8 years due to structural reforms, IN-SPACe, and private sector integration.
• Option A is Incorrect: $20–25 billion is an understated figure below the official projection target.
• Option C is Incorrect: $60–65 billion exceeds the government's medium-term targeted range.
• Option D is Incorrect: $80–90 billion is significantly higher than the present official forecast.

national_questions.qe: Which Union Ministry recently made Aadhaar authentication or proof of possession mandatory for availing scholarship benefits under the PM CARES for Children Scheme?
national_questions.qh: हाल ही में किस केंद्रीय मंत्रालय ने 'पीएम केयर्स फॉर चिल्ड्रेन योजना' के तहत छात्रवृत्ति का लाभ उठाने के लिए आधार सत्यापन या आधार रखने के प्रमाण को अनिवार्य किया है?
oe: Ministry of Women and Child Development
Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct: The Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment issued a notification making Aadhaar authentication mandatory for students to receive scholarship benefits under the PM CARES for Children Scheme.
• Option A is Incorrect: The Ministry of Education oversees general national education policies but did not issue this specific requirement.
• Option B is Incorrect: Although PM CARES for Children was instituted for child welfare, this scholarship authentication rule was formally notified by the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment.
• Option D is Incorrect: The Ministry of Home Affairs is responsible for internal security, not welfare scholarship implementations.

national_questions.qe: Where was India’s first indigenously constructed Multi-Purpose Vessel (MPV), 'INS Samarthak', officially commissioned into the Indian Navy?
national_questions.qh: भारतीय नौसेना के पहले स्वदेशी निर्मित बहुउद्देश्यीय पोत (MPV) 'आईएनएस समर्थक' (INS Samarthak) को किस नौसेना बेस पर कमीशन किया गया?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because INS Samarthak, India's first Multi-Purpose Vessel (MPV) built by a private shipyard with 75% indigenous content, was commissioned at the Karwar Naval Base in Karnataka.
• Option B is Incorrect because Visakhapatnam is the HQ of the Eastern Naval Command, not the commissioning site for INS Samarthak.
• Option C is Incorrect because Kochi serves as the Southern Naval Command headquarters.
• Option D is Incorrect because Mumbai is the Western Naval Command HQ, but the vessel was commissioned at Karwar.

national_questions.qe: At which ISRO center were the critical Crew Module-Service Module (CM-SM) separation tests for the Gaganyaan human spaceflight mission successfully conducted?
national_questions.qh: भारत के गगनयान मानव अंतरिक्ष उड़ान मिशन के लिए महत्वपूर्ण क्रू मॉड्यूल-सर्विस मॉड्यूल (CM-SM) पृथक्करण परीक्षण इसरो के किस केंद्र में सफलतापूर्वक संपन्न हुआ?
oe: U R Rao Satellite Centre (URSC), Bengaluru
oh: यू आर राव उपग्रह केंद्र (URSC), बेंगलुरु
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because the Vikram Sarabhai Space Centre (VSSC) in Thiruvananthapuram successfully conducted the Crew Module-Service Module (CM-SM) separation tests, validating the pyrotechnic separation mechanisms for Gaganyaan.
• Option A is Incorrect because SDSC Sriharikota is the primary spaceport launch facility, not where this separation test took place.
• Option B is Incorrect because SAC Ahmedabad develops payloads and sensors.
• Option D is Incorrect because URSC Bengaluru focuses on satellite design and integration.

national_questions.qe: Which airport in India features the country's first passenger terminal powered by a geothermal-heating system?
national_questions.qh: भारत का पहला भू-तापीय हीटिंग (Geothermal-heating) प्रणाली से संचालित पैसेंजर टर्मिनल किस हवाई अड्डे पर स्थापित किया गया है?
oe: Veer Savarkar International Airport, Port Blair
oh: वीर सावरकर अंतरराष्ट्रीय हवाई अड्डा, पोर्ट ब्लेयर
कुशोक बकुला रिम्पोचे हवाई अड्डा, लेह
श्रीनगर अंतरराष्ट्रीय हवाई अड्डा, जम्मू और कश्मीर
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because Kushok Bakula Rimpochee Airport in Leh, Ladakh, features India's first geothermal-heating powered passenger terminal built at a cost of ₹640 crore.
• Option A is Incorrect because Port Blair airport is located in the Andaman and Nicobar Islands and does not utilize geothermal heating.
• Option C is Incorrect because Pakyong Airport is a greenfield airport in Sikkim.
• Option D is Incorrect because Srinagar International Airport is located in Jammu & Kashmir and does not host this geothermal terminal.

national_questions.qe: Which Indian multi‑wavelength space observatory, launched on 28 September 2015, continues to operate beyond its planned five‑year mission life?
national_questions.qh: 28 सितंबर 2015 को लॉन्च किया गया और नियोजित पाँच‑साल के मिशन जीवन से अधिक कार्यरत रहने वाला भारतीय बहु‑तरंगदैर्घ्य अंतरिक्ष अवलोकन यंत्र कौन‑सा है?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because AstroSat is India’s first dedicated multi‑wavelength space observatory launched on 28 Sep 2015 and has been operating beyond its 5‑year design life.
• Option B is Incorrect because Chandrayaan‑2 is a lunar mission, not a multi‑wavelength observatory.
• Option C is Incorrect because GSAT‑30 is a communication satellite.
• Option D is Incorrect because RISAT‑2 is a radar imaging satellite.

national_questions.qe: The Crew Module–Service Module (CM‑SM) separation tests being conducted in 2026 are part of which Indian human spaceflight mission?
national_questions.qh: 2026 में किए जा रहे क्रू मॉड्यूल‑सर्विस मॉड्यूल (CM‑SM) पृथक्करण परीक्षण किस भारतीय मानव अंतरिक्ष मिशन का हिस्सा हैं?
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because the CM‑SM separation tests are a critical milestone for India’s first crewed mission, Gaganyaan, scheduled for launch by end‑2026.
• Option A is Incorrect; Vikram is the name of the lander for Chandrayaan‑2, not a crewed mission.
• Option C is Incorrect; Shukrayaan is a planned Venus mission.
• Option D is Incorrect; Aditya‑L1 is a solar‑observing satellite.

national_questions.qe: Mormugao Port Authority obtained a 20‑year authorization for a captive non‑public network (CNPN) under which legislation?
national_questions.qh: मोरमुगा पोर्ट अथॉरिटी ने 20‑वर्षीय कैप्टिव नॉन‑पब्लिक नेटवर्क (CNPN) के लिए किस अधिनियम के तहत अनुमति प्राप्त की?
oe: Telecom Regulatory Authority of India Act, 1997
oh: टेलीकॉम रेगुलेटरी अथॉरिटी ऑफ इंडिया अधिनियम, 1997
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because the Department of Telecommunications granted the CNPN authorization to Mormugao Port under the Telecommunications Act 2023.
• Option A is Incorrect; the TRAI Act deals with regulatory functions, not CNPN authorizations.
• Option B is Incorrect; the IT Act pertains to cyber‑law, not telecom network licensing.
• Option D is Incorrect; the policy provides a framework but does not itself confer legal authorization.

national_questions.qe: What is the projected value of India's space economy by the end of the decade as highlighted by Union Minister Dr. Jitendra Singh?
national_questions.qh: जूनियर मंत्री डॉ. जितेंद्र सिंह ने भारत की अंतरिक्ष अर्थव्यवस्था के अनुमानित मूल्य को दशक के अंत तक कितने अरब डॉलर बताया?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because the minister said the space sector is moving towards a $40–45 billion economy.
• Option A is Incorrect because the projected figure is higher than $20‑25 billion.
• Option B is Incorrect as the estimate exceeds $30‑35 billion.
• Option D is Incorrect because the projection does not reach $50‑55 billion.
• Category: Science, Technology, Defense & Space
• Exam Tag: SSC CGL

national_questions.qe: According to the Election Commission's directive, what is the qualifying date for the Special Summary Revision of electoral rolls in the 17 states and UTs?
national_questions.qh: इलेक्शन कमीशन के निर्देश के अनुसार, 17 राज्यों और केंद्र शासित प्रदेशों में विशेष सारांश संशोधन के लिए पात्रता तिथि क्या है?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because the EC specified January 1 as the cut‑off date for eligibility.
• Option B is Incorrect; April 1 is an allowed date for advance applications, not the qualifying date.
• Option C is Incorrect; July 1 is another advance‑application date, not the cut‑off.
• Option D is Incorrect; October 1 is also an advance‑application date, not the qualifying date.
• Category: National Polity, Judiciary & Governance
• Exam Tag: SSC CGL

national_questions.qe: How did External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar describe India's position in the emerging international order at the Bloomberg New Economy Forum?
national_questions.qh: ब्लूमबर्ग न्यू इकोनॉमी फोरम में विदेश मंत्री एस. जैशंकर ने उभरते अंतर्राष्ट्रीय क्रम में भारत की स्थिति को कैसे वर्णित किया?
oe: As a power in the middle
oh: एक मध्य शक्ति के रूप में
मध्य में शक्ति के रूप में
एक वैश्विक महाशक्ति के रूप में
एक क्षेत्रीय गठबंधन नेता के रूप में
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because Jaishankar said India is a “power in the middle” rather than a middle power.
• Option A is Incorrect; he explicitly rejected the term “middle power.”
• Option C is Incorrect; no claim of being a global superpower was made.
• Option D is Incorrect; the statement did not refer to regional bloc leadership.
• Category: International Relations, Summits & Global Organizations
• Exam Tag: SSC CGL

national_questions.qe: Which ministry launched India's first immunocontraception‑based leopard sterilisation programme in Maharashtra?
national_questions.qh: कौन से मंत्रालय ने महाराष्ट्र में भारत का पहला इम्यूनोकॉन्ट्रासेप्शन‑आधारित तेंदुआ नसबंदी कार्यक्रम शुरू किया?
oe: Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change
Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers' Welfare
Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
oh: पर्यावरण, वन और जलवायु परिवर्तन मंत्रालय
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because the programme was launched by the Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change (MoEFCC) through the Junnar forest division, Pune district.
• Option B is Incorrect as the agriculture ministry is not involved in wildlife population control.
• Option C is Incorrect because health ministry deals with human health, not wildlife management.
• Option D is Incorrect; the home ministry handles internal security, not wildlife conservation.

national_questions.qe: Which organization is partnering with Aaka Space for India's first underwater human spaceflight analog mission in Gujarat?
national_questions.qh: गुजरात में भारत के पहले अंडरवॉटर मानव अंतरिक्ष मिशन के लिए आका स्पेस के साथ साझेदारी करने वाला संगठन कौन है?
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because the mission is being conducted in partnership with the Indian Navy, which provides the underwater facility and logistical support.
• Option A is Incorrect; ISRO is a partner in the broader training ecosystem but not the primary partner for the underwater analog.
• Option C is Incorrect as DRDO is not involved in this civilian space‑training initiative.
• Option D is Incorrect because the Ministry of Earth Sciences does not partake in astronaut training missions.

national_questions.qe: India's first geothermal‑heating passenger terminal is being built at which airport?
national_questions.qh: भारत का पहला भू‑तापीय हीटिंग वाला यात्रियों का टर्मिनल किस हवाई अड्डे पर बनाया जा रहा है?
oh: छत्रपति शिवाजी महाराज अंतरराष्ट्रीय हवाई अड्डा
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because the geothermal‑heating passenger terminal is under construction at Kushok Bakula Rimpochee Airport in Leh, Ladakh.
• Option A is Incorrect; Delhi's airport does not have a geothermal heating terminal.
• Option B is Incorrect; Mumbai's airport is not the project site.
• Option D is Incorrect; Bengaluru's airport is unrelated to this Ladakh initiative.

national_questions.qe: Which hospital performed India's first paediatric kidney transplant through donor‑paired exchange?
national_questions.qh: कौन से अस्पताल ने भारत में डोनर‑पेयर्ड एक्सचेंज के माध्यम से पहला बाल किडनी ट्रांसप्लांट किया?
oe: All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Delhi
oh: ऑल इंडिया इंस्टीट्यूट ऑफ मेडिकल साइंसेज़, दिल्ली
national_questions.e:
• Option D is Correct because Aster CMI Hospital, Bengaluru, performed the first paediatric kidney transplant in India using a donor‑paired exchange.
• Option A is Incorrect; AIIMS Delhi has performed kidney transplants but not the first paediatric donor‑paired exchange.
• Option B is Incorrect; Apollo Chennai has not reported this specific milestone.
• Option C is Incorrect; Fortis Mumbai is not the centre of this pioneering procedure.

national_questions.qe: In which Union Territory of India has the first petroglyph conservation park been established?
national_questions.qh: भारत का पहला पेट्रोग्लिफ संरक्षण पार्क किस केंद्र शासित प्रदेश में स्थापित किया गया है?
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because India's first petroglyph conservation park was launched in Ladakh as part of the ₹3,350 crore development projects announced by Prime Minister Narendra Modi.
• Option A is Incorrect because Jammu & Kashmir does not host this park.
• Option C is Incorrect because Himachal Pradesh is unrelated to the project.
• Option D is Incorrect because Uttarakhand is not the location of the park.

national_questions.qe: Which Union Minister inaugurated India's first site museum at the Adichanallur archaeological site in Tamil Nadu?
national_questions.qh: अडिचनल्लूर पुरातात्विक स्थल पर भारत का पहला साइट संग्रहालय किस केंद्रीय मंत्री ने उद्घाटन किया?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because Union Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman inaugurated the museum on 6 August 2023.
• Option B is Incorrect because Amit Shah did not preside over this event.
• Option C is Incorrect because Rajnath Singh was not involved.
• Option D is Incorrect because Smriti Irani was not the inaugurating minister.

national_questions.qe: What was the total foreign direct investment (FDI) inflow recorded by India between 2014 and 2025?
national_questions.qh: 2014 से 2025 के बीच भारत में कुल विदेशी प्रत्यक्ष निवेश (FDI) प्रवाह कितना रहा?
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because India recorded a record over USD 748 billion in FDI inflows between 2014‑2025.
• Option A is Incorrect because the figure is lower than the reported amount.
• Option C is Incorrect because the reported amount does not reach USD 848 billion.
• Option D is Incorrect because the reported amount does not reach USD 948 billion.
• The surge was aided by liberalised sectoral norms allowing up to 74 % FDI in defence and 100 % in telecom, insurance and space sectors.

national_questions.qe: Which Indian parliamentarian reiterated that Jammu and Kashmir remains an integral part of India at the UNGA Fourth Committee?
national_questions.qh: कौन सी भारतीय सांसद ने यूएनजीए चौथे कमेटी में यह दोहराया कि जम्मू और कश्मीर भारत का अभिन्न हिस्सा है?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because MP Mahima Kumari Mewar exercised India’s Right of Reply at the UNGA Fourth Committee, stating that Jammu and Kashmir is an integral and inalienable part of India.
• Option B is Incorrect because Priya Saroj delivered India’s national statement at the UNGA Sixth Committee, not the Fourth Committee.
• Option C is Incorrect because Anmol Sher Bedi spoke at the UNGA First Committee on Disarmament, not on the J&K issue.
• Option D is Incorrect because External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar was not the speaker at the Fourth Committee on this matter.

national_questions.qe: The newly completed Dalli-Rajhara–Rowghat broad gauge rail line project primarily aims to provide railway connectivity to which remote region in Chhattisgarh?
national_questions.qh: हाल ही में पूरी की गई दल्ली-राजहरा-रावघाट बड़ी लाइन रेल परियोजना का प्राथमिक उद्देश्य छत्तीसगढ़ के किस सुदूर क्षेत्र को रेल नेटवर्क से जोड़ना है?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because the 95-km Dalli-Rajhara-Rowghat broad gauge line project (completed at a cost of ₹1,628 crore) connects the remote, mineral-rich Bastar region of Chhattisgarh to the national rail grid.
• Option A is Incorrect because Surguja is located in northern Chhattisgarh.
• Option B is Incorrect because Jaspur lies in the north-eastern part of the state.
• Option D is Incorrect because Koriya is in north-western Chhattisgarh.

national_questions.qe: Which country is set to host the first-ever Civilisation Dialogue Forum under the aegis of the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation (SCO)?
national_questions.qh: शंघाई सहयोग संगठन (SCO) के तत्वावधान में पहले 'सभ्यता संवाद मंच' (Civilisation Dialogue Forum) की मेजबानी कौन सा देश करेगा?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because Defence Minister Rajnath Singh announced at the SCO Council of Heads of Government meeting in Tajikistan that India will host the first SCO Civilisation Dialogue Forum to promote cultural exchange.
• Option B is Incorrect because Tajikistan hosted the SCO Council of Heads of Government meeting where the announcement was made.
• Option C is Incorrect because Uzbekistan hosted previous SCO summits but not this initial dialogue forum.
• Option D is Incorrect because Kazakhstan is an SCO member state but not the host for this event.

national_questions.qe: Which apex national body confers the 'Ustad Bismillah Khan Yuva Puraskar' to outstanding young practitioners in the field of performing arts in India?
national_questions.qh: भारत में प्रदर्शन कलाओं (पर्फॉर्मिंग आर्ट्स) के क्षेत्र में उत्कृष्ट युवा कलाकारों को 'उस्ताद बिस्मिल्लाह खान युवा पुरस्कार' किस शीर्ष राष्ट्रीय संस्था द्वारा प्रदान किया जाता है?
national_questions.e:
• Option D is Correct because the Ustad Bismillah Khan Yuva Puraskar is presented annually by the Sangeet Natak Akademi to recognize young talent (up to 40 years of age) in music, dance, and drama.
• Option A is Incorrect because Lalit Kala Akademi focuses on visual arts like painting and sculpture.
• Option B is Incorrect because Sahitya Akademi promotes Indian literature.
• Option C is Incorrect because NSD is an autonomous theatre training institute.

national_questions.qe: Which statutory body facilitated the export consignment of NPOP and EU-certified organic Palmyra jaggery powder from Tamil Nadu to Bulgaria?
national_questions.qh: तमिलनाडु से बुल्गारिया को एनपीओपी (NPOP) और यूरोपीय संघ द्वारा प्रमाणित जैविक ताड़ के गुड़ के पाउडर (Organic Palmyra Jaggery Powder) के निर्यात को किस वैधानिक निकाय ने सुगम बनाया?
oe: Agricultural and Processed Food Products Export Development Authority (APEDA)
oh: कृषि और प्रसंस्कृत खाद्य उत्पाद निर्यात विकास प्राधिकरण (APEDA)
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because APEDA facilitated the export of 1.755 metric tonnes of organic Palmyra jaggery powder, harvested from 137 acres in Erode, Tamil Nadu, to Bulgaria under NPOP and EU organic certifications.
• Option A is Incorrect because MPEDA promotes seafood and marine exports.
• Option C is Incorrect because the Spices Board oversees spices trade.
• Option D is Incorrect because Coffee Board handles coffee production and export.

national_questions.qe: Which Union Minister announced that India will host the first SCO Civilisational Dialogue Forum by the end of 2026?
national_questions.qh: कौन से केंद्रीय मंत्री ने घोषणा की कि भारत 2026 के अंत तक पहला एससीओ सिविलाइज़ेशन डायलॉग फ़ोरम आयोजित करेगा?
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because Union Defence Minister Rajnath Singh announced at the SCO Council of Heads of Government meeting in Dushanbe that India will host the first SCO Civilisational Dialogue Forum by the end of 2026.
• Option A is Incorrect because Dr. S. Jaishankar, the External Affairs Minister, did not make this specific announcement.
• Option C is Incorrect because Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman was not involved in this declaration.
• Option D is Incorrect because Home Minister Amit Shah was not the announcing authority.

national_questions.qe: Which minister highlighted the significance of PM Narendra Modi's 25‑year tenure as head of government in the Union Cabinet resolution?
national_questions.qh: कौन से मंत्री ने केंद्रीय मंत्रिमंडल के प्रस्ताव में प्रधानमंत्री नरेंद्र मोदी के 25‑वर्षीय कार्यकाल के महत्व को उजागर किया?
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because Information and Broadcasting Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw, during the Cabinet meeting, emphasized that the 25‑year tenure reflects the strength, vitality and maturity of Indian democracy.
• Option A is Incorrect because Amit Shah, the Home Minister, did not make the highlighted statement.
• Option C is Incorrect because Nitin Gadkari, the Minister for Road Transport & Highways, was not part of this specific commentary.
• Option D is Incorrect because Piyush Goyal, the Minister for Commerce & Industry, was not the speaker on this matter.

national_questions.qe: Which Indian authority signed the Memorandum of Cooperation on Electronic Origin Data Exchange with New Zealand under the FTA?
national_questions.qh: भारत और न्यूज़ीलैंड के बीच इलेक्ट्रॉनिक मूल डेटा एक्सचेंज पर समझौता ज्ञापन (MoC) किस भारतीय प्राधिकरण द्वारा हस्ताक्षरित किया गया?
oe: Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs (CBIC)
oh: केंद्रीय अप्रत्यक्ष कर एवं सीमा बोर्ड (CBIC)
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because the MoC was signed by CBIC Chairman Vivek Chaturvedi on behalf of India.
• Option B is Incorrect; the Ministry of Commerce is not the signing authority for customs data exchange.
• Option C is Incorrect; the Ministry of External Affairs facilitated the agreement but did not sign.
• Option D is Incorrect; DGFT deals with export‑import policy, not customs origin data.

national_questions.qe: In the trilateral meeting held in Mumbai, which two countries' foreign ministers met with India's External Affairs Minister?
national_questions.qh: मुंबई में आयोजित त्रिपक्षीय बैठक में भारत के विदेश मंत्री के साथ किन दो देशों के विदेश मंत्रियों ने भाग लिया?
oe: United Arab Emirates and United States
oh: यूनाइटेड किंगडम और संयुक्त राज्य अमेरिका
संयुक्त अरब अमीरात और संयुक्त राज्य अमेरिका
सऊदी अरब और संयुक्त राज्य अमेरिका
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because the meeting involved UAE Foreign Minister Sheikh Abdullah bin Zayed Al Nahyan and US Secretary of State Marco Rubio.
• Option A is Incorrect; the UK was not part of this trilateral dialogue.
• Option C is Incorrect; Saudi Arabia was not present in this meeting.
• Option D is Incorrect; Japan was not a participant.

national_questions.qe: Which Indian ministry's secretary chaired the virtual meeting on the proposed electrical interconnection with Saudi Arabia?
national_questions.qh: भारत और सऊदी अरब के बीच प्रस्तावित विद्युत अंतरसंबंध पहल पर वर्चुअल बैठक का संचालन किस भारतीय मंत्रालय के सचिव ने किया?
oe: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because Secretary Pankaj Agarwal of the Ministry of Power led the discussion.
• Option A is Incorrect; the Ministry of New & Renewable Energy was not the lead agency.
• Option B is Incorrect; the Ministry of External Affairs facilitated but did not chair the technical meeting.
• Option D is Incorrect; the Ministry of Commerce was not involved in the electrical interconnection talks.

national_questions.qe: Which Indian space mission, launched on 2 September 2023, is the country's first dedicated space‑based observatory placed at the Sun‑Earth L1 point?
national_questions.qh: कौन सा भारतीय अंतरिक्ष मिशन, जो 2 सितंबर 2023 को लॉन्च हुआ, भारत का पहला समर्पित अंतरिक्ष‑आधारित अवलोकन मिशन है जो सूर्य‑पृथ्वी L1 बिंदु पर स्थित है?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because Aditya‑L1, launched on 2 September 2023, is India’s first dedicated space‑based solar observatory placed in a halo orbit around the Sun‑Earth L1 point for a planned 5‑year mission.
• Option B is Incorrect because Chandrayaan‑3 is a lunar‑surface mission, not a solar observatory.
• Option C is Incorrect because Gaganyaan is a crewed orbital programme, not an observatory at L1.
• Option D is Incorrect because Mangalyaan‑2 (if it were to exist) would be a Mars mission, not related to the Sun‑Earth L1 point.

national_questions.qe: The first immunocontraception‑based leopard sterilisation program in India was launched by which forest division?
national_questions.qh: भारत में पहला इम्यूनोकॉन्ट्रासेप्शन‑आधारित तेंदुआ नसबंदी कार्यक्रम किस वन विभाग द्वारा शुरू किया गया?
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because the pilot immunocontraception programme for leopard population control was inaugurated by the Junnar Forest Division in Pune, Maharashtra, under MoEFCC.
• Option A is Incorrect because Bandipur Forest Division operates in Karnataka and has not launched this specific programme.
• Option C is Incorrect because the Sundarbans Forest Division deals with mangrove ecosystems, not leopard management.
• Option D is Incorrect because Jim Corbett Forest Division, while a tiger reserve, is not the initiating agency for the leopard sterilisation pilot.

national_questions.qe: Which ministry was primarily responsible for facilitating the return of over 3,000 stranded Umrah pilgrims from Saudi Arabia?
national_questions.qh: सऊदी अरब से 3,000 से अधिक फंसे उमराह यात्रियों की वापसी को सुविधाजनक बनाने के लिए मुख्य रूप से कौन सा मंत्रालय जिम्मेदार था?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because the MEA set up 24x7 control rooms at its Embassy in Riyadh and Consulate in Jeddah to assist stranded pilgrims.
• Option B is Incorrect because the Home Ministry deals with internal security, not diplomatic repatriation.
• Option C is Incorrect because Civil Aviation handles airline operations, not diplomatic assistance.
• Option D is Incorrect because Tourism is not the nodal agency for pilgrim repatriation.

national_questions.qe: The one‑trillion‑dollar chemicals market target by 2040 was announced under which scheme?
national_questions.qh: 2040 तक एक ट्रिलियन डॉलर के रासायनिक बाजार लक्ष्य की घोषणा किस योजना के तहत की गई थी?
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because Union Minister J.P. Nadda announced the target under the ‘Bhavya Rasayan’ scheme, providing Rs 1,000 crore per chemical park.
• Option A is Incorrect; Make in India is a broader manufacturing initiative, not specific to chemicals.
• Option C is Incorrect; the National Chemical Policy outlines guidelines but does not contain the grant scheme.
• Option D is Incorrect; ‘Chemistry for India’ is not an official government scheme.

national_questions.qe: From which state was the nationwide ‘Khet Bachao Abhiyan‑Rabi 2026’ launched?
national_questions.qh: ‘खेती बचाओ अभियान‑रबी 2026’ का राष्ट्रीय स्तर पर शुभारंभ किस राज्य से किया गया?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because Union Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan launched the campaign from Karnal, Haryana.
• Option A is Incorrect; Punjab was not the launch venue.
• Option B is Incorrect; Uttar Pradesh was not involved in the launch.
• Option D is Incorrect; Rajasthan was not the launch location.

national_questions.qe: What is the exact deadline set by the Union Home Minister to eliminate the drug menace from India?
national_questions.qh: भारत से ड्रग समस्या को समाप्त करने के लिए केंद्रीय गृह मंत्री द्वारा निर्धारित अंतिम तिथि क्या है?
national_questions.e:
• Option D is Correct because Amit Shah announced a national deadline of 31 December 2029 to eradicate the drug menace.
• Option A is Incorrect; the year 2027 was not mentioned.
• Option B is Incorrect; the year 2028 was not mentioned.
• Option C is Incorrect; the deadline is 2029, not 2030.

national_questions.qe: At which airport did Captain Smit Machchhar safely land the Flydubai flight after thwarting a hijack attempt?
national_questions.qh: कैप्टन स्मित मच्छर ने बंधक बनाने के प्रयास को रोकने के बाद Flydubai उड़ान को किस हवाई अड्डे पर सुरक्षित रूप से उतारा?
oh: रियाद किंग खलीद अंतरराष्ट्रीय हवाई अड्डा
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because the flight was diverted and landed safely at Tabuk Regional Airport in Saudi Arabia after Captain Machchhar subdued the hijacker, saving 174 lives.
• Option B is Incorrect because the flight originated from Dubai and did not return there.
• Option C is Incorrect because Abu Dhabi was not involved in the incident.
• Option D is Incorrect because the aircraft did not land in Riyadh.

national_questions.qe: Which Indian Institute launched the country's first one‑year full‑time residential MBA programme in Investment and Wealth Management?
national_questions.qh: कौन सा भारतीय संस्थान निवेश और धन प्रबंधन में देश का पहला एक‑साल पूर्ण‑कालिक आवासीय एमबीए कार्यक्रम शुरू किया?
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because IIM Udaipur launched India’s first one‑year full‑time residential MBA in Investment and Wealth Management, developed in collaboration with leading financial firms.
• Option A is Incorrect because IIM Ahmedabad has not introduced such a specialised one‑year programme.
• Option C is Incorrect as IIM Bangalore offers other MBA formats but not this specific programme.
• Option D is Incorrect; IIM Calcutta does not offer the mentioned one‑year residential MBA in this domain.

national_questions.qe: Which Union Ministry organized the national virtual conference focusing on the convergence between Jal Jeevan Mission 2.0 and the 16th Finance Commission?
national_questions.qh: जल जीवन मिशन (JJM) 2.0 और 16वें वित्त आयोग के मध्य अभिसरण पर राष्ट्रीय वर्चुअल सम्मेलन का आयोजन किस केंद्रीय मंत्रालय द्वारा किया गया?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because the Department of Drinking Water and Sanitation (DDWS) under the Ministry of Jal Shakti organized the conference to ensure water security and rural drinking water sustainability.
• Option A is Incorrect because the Ministry of Rural Development focuses on rural livelihoods and employment schemes, not JJM 2.0 execution.
• Option B is Incorrect because the Ministry of Panchayati Raj is a facilitating partner, but the convening body is Jal Shakti.
• Option D is Incorrect because the Ministry of Finance determines devolution grants but was not the host ministry.

national_questions.qe: Which public sector bank signed an MoU with C-DAC to develop indigenous quantum technologies for the financial sector?
national_questions.qh: वित्तीय क्षेत्र के लिए स्वदेशी क्वांटम तकनीक विकसित करने हेतु सी-डैक (C-DAC) के साथ किस सार्वजनिक क्षेत्र के बैंक ने समझौता ज्ञापन पर हस्ताक्षर किए हैं?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because the Centre for Development of Advanced Computing (C-DAC) partnered with Bank of India (BOI) to build a Quantum Ecosystem for Financial Innovation.
• Option B is Incorrect because State Bank of India is not the collaborating bank in this specific initiative.
• Option C is Incorrect because Punjab National Bank is not part of this C-DAC agreement.
• Option D is Incorrect because Canara Bank is not the signing entity for this quantum computing collaboration.

national_questions.qe: Which district in Manipur serves as the major stopover site for satellite-tagged Amur falcons to build fat reserves during their annual cross-continental migration?
national_questions.qh: उपग्रह-टैग किए गए अमूर फाल्कन्स के वार्षिक अंतर-महाद्वीपीय प्रवास के दौरान ऊर्जा संचय के लिए मणिपुर का कौन सा जिला मुख्य पड़ाव (स्टॉपओवर) स्थल के रूप में कार्य करता है?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because Tamenglong district in Manipur serves as the primary stopover site where satellite-tagged Amur falcons (such as 'Apapang' and 'Alang') gather to build fat reserves before their non-stop 6,000 km trans-oceanic flight across the Arabian Sea to Somalia.
• Option B is Incorrect because Ukhrul is famous for the endemic Shirui Lily flower and is not the central staging area for Amur falcon tagging studies by WII.
• Option C is Incorrect because Churachandpur is located in southern Manipur and is not the primary roosting site for these migratory raptors.
• Option D is Incorrect because Bishnupur is home to Loktak Lake and Keibul Lamjao National Park, not the main Amur falcon stopover hub.

national_questions.qe: In which sporting discipline did the Indian duo Sheetal Devi and Toman Kumar set a World Record and win Gold at the Asian Para Games in Aichi-Nagoya?
national_questions.qh: आईची-नागोया में आयोजित एशियाई पैरा खेलों में भारतीय जोड़ी शीतल देवी और तोमन कुमार ने किस खेल स्पर्धा में नया विश्व रिकॉर्ड बनाते हुए स्वर्ण पदक जीता?
oh: पैरा शूटिंग - 10 मीटर एयर राइफल मिक्स्ड
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because top-seeded Indian armless archer Sheetal Devi and Toman Kumar set a World Record in qualification and clinched the Compound Mixed Team gold medal by defeating Indonesia 151-148 at the Asian Para Games in Aichi-Nagoya.
• Option A is Incorrect because Suvarna Raj won gold in women's F-54 discus throw, not Sheetal Devi and Toman Kumar.
• Option C is Incorrect because mixed doubles badminton was a different event category at the Games.
• Option D is Incorrect because shooting events were contested in different classification categories.

national_questions.qe: At which historic site is the annual Dhammachakra Pravartan Day celebrated to mark Dr. B.R. Ambedkar embracing Buddhism in 1956?
national_questions.qh: वर्ष 1956 में डॉ. बी.आर. अंबेडकर द्वारा बौद्ध धर्म अपनाने के ऐतिहासिक अवसर की स्मृति में प्रतिवर्ष 'धम्मचक्र प्रवर्तन दिवस' किस स्थल पर मनाया जाता है?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because Deekshabhoomi in Nagpur, Maharashtra, is the sacred monument where Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar formally embraced Buddhism along with millions of his followers on Vijayadashami, October 14, 1956.
• Option A is Incorrect because Chaitya Bhoomi in Dadar, Mumbai, is the cremation site and memorial place of Dr. B.R. Ambedkar.
• Option B is Incorrect because Mahabodhi Temple in Gaya, Bihar, is where Lord Buddha attained enlightenment.
• Option D is Incorrect because Sarnath near Varanasi is where Lord Buddha delivered his first sermon (Dhammacakkappavattana Sutta).

national_questions.qe: Which premier technical institution in India has introduced the country’s first academic credit course on ‘Goodness’ to integrate moral education and ethics into higher learning?
national_questions.qh: उच्च शिक्षा में नैतिक मूल्यों और सामाजिक उत्तरदायित्व को एकीकृत करने के लिए किस भारतीय प्रौद्योगिकी संस्थान (IIT) ने 'गुडनेस' (Goodness) पर भारत का पहला शैक्षणिक क्रेडिट पाठ्यक्रम शुरू किया है?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because IIT Hyderabad, under the Ministry of Education, introduced India's first academic credit course on 'Goodness' to offer formal credits for ethical values and social responsibility.
• Option A is Incorrect because IIT Madras is not the institution that introduced this specific course.
• Option B is Incorrect because IIT Bombay did not launch this credit course.
• Option D is Incorrect because IIT Delhi is not associated with this initiative.

national_questions.qe: Who became the first Indian wrestler to win a silver medal in the Greco-Roman category at the U23 World Wrestling Championships?
national_questions.qh: U23 विश्व कुश्ती चैंपियनशिप में ग्रीको-रोमन श्रेणी में रजत पदक जीतने वाले पहले भारतीय पहलवान कौन बने हैं?
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because Vishvajit More secured India’s first U23 Greco-Roman silver medal at the World Wrestling Championships in Las Vegas.
• Option A is Incorrect because Aman Sehrawat competes in freestyle wrestling.
• Option C is Incorrect because Antim Panghal is a prominent Indian women's wrestler.
• Option D is Incorrect because Sujan Kundu is not the wrestler who won this historic U23 Greco-Roman silver.

national_questions.qe: Putul Sonowal, who secured India’s first-ever medal at the World Bowls Champion of Champions, hails from which Indian state?
national_questions.qh: ऑस्ट्रेलिया में आयोजित वर्ल्ड बाउल्स चैम्पियन ऑफ चैंपियंस में भारत का पहला पदक हासिल करने वाले पुतुल सोनोवाल का संबंध किस भारतीय राज्य से है?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because Putul Sonowal hails from Assam and achieved India’s first podium finish by reaching the semi-finals at the World Bowls Champion of Champions in Barham, Australia.
• Option B is Incorrect because Putul Sonowal is from Assam, not Manipur.
• Option C is Incorrect because Odisha is not his native state.
• Option D is Incorrect because Jharkhand is not associated with this player.

national_questions.qe: In collaboration with HCL Group AI Labs, which institution has established India's first Agentic AI Campus to integrate AI-driven learning into its academic curriculum?
national_questions.qh: एचसीएल ग्रुप एआई लैब्स के सहयोग से, किस संस्थान ने अपने पाठ्यक्रम में एआई-संचालित प्रोजेक्ट-आधारित शिक्षण को एकीकृत करने के लिए भारत का पहला 'एजेंटिक एआई कैंपस' स्थापित किया है?
national_questions.e:
• Option D is Correct because KLH Hyderabad (Bachupally) partnered with HCL Group AI Labs to launch India’s first Agentic AI Campus to embed AI-driven project-based learning.
• Option A is Incorrect because BITS Pilani is not associated with this specific partnership.
• Option B is Incorrect because IIT Kanpur did not launch this campus with HCL.
• Option C is Incorrect because SRM University is not the designated institution.

national_questions.qe: Which council reviewed the progress of the 'Your Money, Your Right' campaign and discussed cybersecurity preparedness?
national_questions.qh: कौन सी परिषद ने 'Your Money, Your Right' अभियान की प्रगति की समीक्षा की और साइबर सुरक्षा की तैयारी पर चर्चा की?
oe: Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI)
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because the 30th meeting of the Financial Stability and Development Council (FSDC) reviewed the 'Your Money, Your Right' campaign and cybersecurity.
• Option A is Incorrect as RBI chaired the meeting but the council discussed the agenda.
• Option C is Incorrect because NITI Aayog was not the body conducting the review.
• Option D is Incorrect because SEBI was not involved in this specific meeting.

national_questions.qe: Under the Export Promotion Mission (EPM), which sub‑scheme provides full cost coverage for international certifications to MSEs?
national_questions.qh: एक्सपोर्ट प्रमोशन मिशन (EPM) के तहत माइक्रो और स्मॉल एंटरप्राइज़ (MSEs) के लिए अंतरराष्ट्रीय प्रमाणपत्रों की पूरी लागत कवरेज किस उप-योजना द्वारा प्रदान की जाती है?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because the EPM assistance for full cost of international certifications is delivered through both sub‑schemes – Niryat Protsahan and Niryat Disha.
• Option A is Incorrect as Niryat Protsahan alone does not cover the entire certification cost.
• Option B is Incorrect as Niryat Disha alone does not cover the entire certification cost.
• Option D is Incorrect because the scheme does provide such coverage.

national_questions.qe: The Digital Agriculture Mission originally set the target of creating 11 crore Farmer IDs by the end of which fiscal year?
national_questions.qh: डिजिटल एग्रीकल्चर मिशन के तहत 11 करोड़ किसान आईडी बनाने का मूल लक्ष्य किस वित्तीय वर्ष के अंत तक निर्धारित था?
national_questions.e:
• Option D is Correct because the Ministry of Agriculture set the 11 crore Farmer ID target to be achieved by March 2027.
• Option A is Incorrect as the target was not set for 2025.
• Option B is Incorrect because the deadline was later than 2026.
• Option C is Incorrect; 2028 exceeds the original timeline.

national_questions.qe: Which statement correctly reflects India's defence export policy as announced by the Defence Secretary?
national_questions.qh: कौन सा कथन रक्षा सचिव द्वारा घोषित भारत की रक्षा निर्यात नीति को सही रूप से दर्शाता है?
oe: India aims to spend 75 % of annual defence capital expenditure on Indian‑designed, developed and manufactured products.
India aims to export 75 % of its defence production to foreign markets.
India aims to reduce defence exports to the European Union to below 10 % of total exports.
India aims to increase imports of foreign weapons to 75 % of its defence capital expenditure.
oh: भारत का लक्ष्य वार्षिक रक्षा पूँजी खर्च का 75 % भारतीय‑डिज़ाइन, विकसित और निर्मित उत्पादों पर खर्च करना है।
भारत का लक्ष्य अपनी रक्षा उत्पादन का 75 % विदेशी बाजारों में निर्यात करना है।
भारत का लक्ष्य यूरोपीय संघ को निर्यात को कुल निर्यात के 10 % से नीचे घटाना है।
भारत का लक्ष्य अपने रक्षा पूँजी खर्च का 75 % विदेशी हथियारों के आयात पर खर्च करना है।
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because the Defence Secretary stated that 75 % of annual defence capital expenditure will be met domestically with Indian‑designed, developed and manufactured products.
• Option B is Incorrect; the policy focuses on domestic procurement, not export share.
• Option C is Incorrect; there is no target to cut EU exports to 10 %.
• Option D is Incorrect; the aim is to increase domestic content, not foreign imports.

national_questions.qe: Under the Export Promotion Mission (EPM), which cost will the Government bear for micro and small enterprises?
national_questions.qh: एक्सपोर्ट प्रमोशन मिशन (EPM) के तहत, सरकार माइक्रो और स्मॉल उद्यमों के लिए कौन सा खर्च वहन करेगी?
oe: Entire cost of expensive certifications required for export.
oh: निर्यात के लिए आवश्यक महँगी प्रमाणपत्रों की पूरी लागत।
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because the announcement by Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal states that the government will bear the full cost of certifications for MSMEs under EPM.
• Option A is Incorrect; raw material costs are not covered under this scheme.
• Option C is Incorrect; salary subsidies are not mentioned.
• Option D is Incorrect; customs duties remain the responsibility of the exporter.

national_questions.qe: What is the projected electricity demand from AI and large‑scale data centres in India for FY 2031‑32?

national_questions.qe: At which UN forum did India raise concerns about Pakistan's minority‑rights violations and military control?

national_questions.qe: In which Indian state was the RBI Data Centre and Cybersecurity Training Institute inaugurated by the Prime Minister?
national_questions.qh: प्रधानमंत्री द्वारा RBI डेटा सेंटर और साइबर सुरक्षा प्रशिक्षण संस्थान किस भारतीय राज्य में उद्घाटित किया गया?
national_questions.e:

national_questions.qe: Which act replaced the Mahatma Gandhi NREGA and guarantees 125 days of wage employment per rural household?
national_questions.qh: कौन सा अधिनियम महात्मा गांधी एनआरईजी को प्रतिस्थापित कर ग्रामीण घरानों को 125 दिन वेतन रोजगार की गारंटी देता है?
oe: Viksit Bharat - Guarantee for Rozgar and Ajeevika Mission (Gramin) Act, 2025
Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act

महात्मा गांधी राष्ट्रीय ग्रामीण रोजगार गारंटी अधिनियम

• Option A is Correct because the Viksit Bharat‑Guarantee for Rozgar and Ajeevika Mission (Gramin) Act, 2025 came into force on 1 July 2026, succeeding Mahatma Gandhi NREGA and statutorily guarantees 125 days of wage employment per rural household each financial year.

• Option C is Incorrect as it refers to an older, unrelated legislation.
• Option D is Incorrect; it is a livelihood scheme, not a statutory employment guarantee act.

national_questions.qe: The Integrated Atmospheric Chemistry and Aerosol Toxicity Analysis Laboratory (AATAL) was established under which mission?
national_questions.qh: इंटीग्रेटेड एटमॉस्फेरिक केमिस्ट्री और एयरोसोल टॉक्सिसिटी एनालिसिस लैबोरेटरी (AATAL) किस मिशन के तहत स्थापित की गई है?
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because AATAL was set up under ‘Mission Mausam’, the Ministry of Earth Sciences initiative aimed at enhancing atmospheric monitoring and real‑time air‑quality forecasting.
• Option A is Incorrect; the National Clean Air Programme is a policy framework, not the specific mission under which AATAL was created.
• Option C is Incorrect; Swachh Bharat Mission deals with sanitation, unrelated to atmospheric chemistry.
• Option D is Incorrect; Pradhan Mantri Vayu Shakti Yojana focuses on renewable energy, not air‑pollution analysis.

national_questions.qe: India and China agreed to use which channels for managing the Line of Actual Control (LAC)?
national_questions.qh: भारत और चीन ने लाइन ऑफ़ एक्चुअल कंट्रोल (LAC) प्रबंधन के लिए कौन से चैनलों का उपयोग करने पर सहमति जताई?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because the Ministry of External Affairs stated that India and China will discuss measures through diplomatic and military channels to improve understanding of the LAC and avoid miscalculations.
• Option A is Incorrect; economic trade forums were not mentioned in the agreement.
• Option B is Incorrect; cultural exchanges were not part of the LAC‑management discussion.
• Option D is Incorrect; there was no reference to judicial arbitration for LAC issues.

national_questions.qe: Which ministry is the nodal agency for the diplomatic and military mechanisms used by India and China to resolve issues along the Line of Actual Control (LAC)?
national_questions.qh: भारत और चीन के बीच वास्तविक नियंत्रण रेखा (एलएसी) के मुद्दों को सुलझाने के लिए उपयोग किए जाने वाले कूटनीतिक और सैन्य तंत्र के लिए कौन सा मंत्रालय मुख्य एजेंसी है?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because the Ministry of External Affairs (MEA) issued the statement that India and China use existing diplomatic and military mechanisms to resolve LAC issues.
• Option B is Incorrect because while the Defence Ministry handles military aspects, the overall diplomatic mechanism is under MEA.
• Option C is Incorrect as the Home Ministry deals with internal security, not bilateral border mechanisms.
• Option D is Incorrect because the Commerce Ministry is unrelated to border management or diplomatic negotiations.

national_questions.qe: Who exercised India's right of reply at the United Nations to counter Pakistan's statements on religious freedom and minority rights in Jammu & Kashmir?
national_questions.qh: जम्मू और कश्मीर में धार्मिक स्वतंत्रता और अल्पसंख्यकों के अधिकारों पर पाकिस्तान के बयानों का जवाब देने के लिए भारत ने संयुक्त राष्ट्र में किस अधिकारी ने अधिकार प्रयोग किया?
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because First Secretary Bhavika Mangalanandan, at India’s Permanent Mission to the UN, exercised the right of reply against Pakistan’s statements.
• Option A is Incorrect as Ambassador Tirumurti is the Foreign Secretary, not the UN mission officer who replied.
• Option C is Incorrect because Permanent Representative Ruchira Kamboj is the chief UN envoy but did not personally give the reply in this instance.
• Option D is Incorrect; Deputy Permanent Representative Arindam Bagchi did not deliver the reply.

national_questions.qe: In which district of Andhra Pradesh has India’s first autonomous maritime shipyard been inaugurated?
national_questions.qh: आंध्र प्रदेश के किस जिले में भारत का पहला स्वायत्त समुद्री शिपयार्ड स्थापित किया गया है?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because the autonomous maritime shipyard and systems development centre has been launched at Juvvaladinne Fishing Harbour in Nellore district, Andhra Pradesh.
• Option B is Incorrect because Visakhapatnam district hosts other naval facilities but not this autonomous shipyard.
• Option C is Incorrect because Kakinada district is known for a port but not the location of this project.
• Option D is Incorrect because Guntur district has no maritime shipyard under this initiative.

national_questions.qe: Which dedicated digital storefront was launched on the Government e-Marketplace (GeM) to feature One District, One Product (ODOP) and Geographical Indication (GI) tagged items?
national_questions.qh: वन डिस्ट्रिक्ट, वन प्रोडक्ट (ODOP) और भौगोलिक संकेत (GI) टैग प्राप्त वस्तुओं को प्रदर्शित करने के लिए गवर्नमेंट ई-मार्केटप्लेस (GeM) पर किस समर्पित डिजिटल स्टोरफ्रंट का शुभारंभ किया गया है?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because the Government e-Marketplace (GeM) launched 'The AABHAR Collection', a dedicated storefront featuring 294 ODOP and GI-tagged product listings from 10 state and central handloom and handicraft emporiums.
• Option B is Incorrect because 'The HUNAR Collection' is not the designated storefront for ODOP and GI products on GeM.
• Option C is Incorrect because 'The VIKAS Collection' is an incorrect naming option.
• Option D is Incorrect because 'The SAMRIDDHI Collection' is not associated with this GeM initiative.

national_questions.qe: Which organization provides 95% risk coverage to Indian exporters under Component II of the RELIEF scheme to counter geopolitical logistics disruptions?
national_questions.qh: भू-राजनीतिक रसद व्यवधानों से निपटने के लिए RELIEF योजना के घटक II के तहत भारतीय निर्यातकों को 95% जोखिम कवरेज कौन सी संस्था प्रदान करती है?
oe: Export Credit Guarantee Corporation of India (ECGC)
national_questions.e:

• Option A is Incorrect because EXIM Bank provides export finance and cross-border project financing, not insurance risk coverage under RELIEF.
• Option B is Incorrect because FIEO is an apex trade promotion council.
• Option C is Incorrect because DGFT formulates policy rules, whereas ECGC administers the credit risk insurance coverage.

national_questions.qe: Chandrayaan-5, a planned joint lunar mission featuring a 350 kg rover for surface experiments, is a collaborative initiative between ISRO and which international space agency?
national_questions.qh: 350 किलोग्राम वजनी रोवर के साथ सतह के प्रयोगों के लिए नियोजित संयुक्त चंद्र मिशन 'चंद्रयान-5', इसरो (ISRO) और किस अंतर्राष्ट्रीय अंतरिक्ष एजेंसी की एक संयुक्त पहल है?

• Option C is Correct: Chandrayaan-5 is a joint lunar exploration mission planned between India's ISRO and Japan's JAXA, featuring a 350 kg rover designed for 100 days of surface experiments.
• Option A is Incorrect: NASA is the space agency of the United States.
• Option B is Incorrect: ESA represents European nations in space activities.

national_questions.qe: Which city hosted the 12th BRICS Parliamentary Forum, centered on the theme 'Fostering Parliaments for People-Centric Development'?

national_questions.e:

national_questions.qe: The 'Nav-Trinjan' initiative, dedicated to promoting naturally colored organic cotton cultivation and establishing traditional weaving schools, was launched in which Indian state?

national_questions.qe: Which Indian ministry's Minister of State visited Samoa and Nauru (Naoero) under the FIPIC framework in 2024?

national_questions.qe: Which legislation is being amended to introduce criminal provisions for doping violations in India?
national_questions.qh: भारत में डोपिंग उल्लंघनों के लिए आपराधिक प्रावधान जोड़ने हेतु किस विधेयक में संशोधन किया जा रहा है?

national_questions.qe: The 'Concessional Local Pass' for non‑commercial vehicle owners near National Highway toll plazas is notified under which rule?

national_questions.qe: Which Indian Navy ship participated in the 33rd SIMBEX‑2026 maritime exercise?

national_questions.qe: Which institute is establishing India's first dedicated school for Physical Artificial Intelligence?

national_questions.qe: How many drug‑quality detector machines has Maharashtra deployed, becoming the first state to do so?
national_questions.qh: महाराष्ट्र ने कितनी ड्रग क्वालिटी डिटेक्टर मशीनें स्थापित की हैं, जिससे वह पहला राज्य बना?
national_questions.e:

bihar_questions.qe: Under the National Education Policy (NEP), the Bihar Education Department plans to introduce additional regional languages for students of which class group in government schools?

bihar_questions.qe: Which policy launched by the Bihar Government in 2026 mandates procurement preference for goods where at least 25% of manufacturing occurs within the state?

• Option C is Incorrect; the National Manufacturing Policy is a central policy and does not apply specifically to Bihar’s purchase preferences.

bihar_questions.qe: Which ministry is the nodal agency for the Varanasi–Kolkata Greenfield Expressway under the Bharatmala Pariyojana?

bihar_questions.qe: Which Union ministry was recommended by the Bihar District Court to overhaul the training curriculum of IAS and IPS officers?

bihar_questions.qe: Which state notified the Ease of Doing Business Act, 2026, to replace permission-based industrial clearances with self-certification and time-bound approvals?
bihar_questions.qh: अनुमति-आधारित औद्योगिक स्वीकृतियों के स्थान पर स्व-प्रमाणन और समयबद्ध मंजूरी की व्यवस्था लागू करने के लिए किस राज्य ने ईज़ ऑफ डूइंग बिजनेस अधिनियम, 2026 अधिसूचित किया है?

bihar_questions.qe: The Gangata forest section, which requires forest clearance for the widening of National Highway-333, is located in which wildlife sanctuary of Bihar?

bihar_questions.qe: In which southern Indian state is the Bihar Labour Resource Department establishing 'Shram Seva Suvidha Kendra' across Chennai, Coimbatore, and Tiruppur to support migrant workers?

bihar_questions.e:

• Option A is Incorrect because Karnataka is not the state where these specific three hubs are being set up under this phase.

• Option C is Incorrect; those articles deal with equality before law and protection against discrimination, but were not cited.

bihar_questions.qe: In which tourist location of Bihar is a dedicated emporium being constructed to provide global market access for products made by Jeevika self-help groups?
